content: {"praised":["Survival-horror atmosphere captured from the original game.","Special effects, especially Dark Nurses and Pyramid Head, were amazing.","Good translation of video game to film.","Strong visual style and haunting music.","Engaging horror tone and suspenseful pacing."],"criticized":["Characters lacked depth and emotional connection.","Story was predictable and contrived.","Film never let up, too intense.","Gore and violence felt gratuitous.","Ending was too obvious and disappointing."]}
